meta.description: Standalone M6S H1 Astrologian timeline. Boss timings follow the current public r6s timeline. AST healing follows the linked M5S-M8S source's pragmatic prog/farm philosophy: Earthly Star and Macrocosmos are aligned to meaningful damage windows rather than forced on cooldown. Practical party-finder burst reminders use opener, 124s, 258s, 360.5s, 480s and 600s. DoT reminders follow an approximately 30-second refresh cycle; during the add phase they refer to the current priority add, and the cycle is reset after the long add phase when the boss returns. This file remains separate from all Scholar timelines. The 361s call was split into two cues (Earthly Star at 361s, DoT refresh plus Lightspeed/Divination at 364s) because the single combined line measured 16.5 units and tripped the long-text warning; the 21.7s gap before the next cue leaves the 2000ms collision window empty.
